arduino_sd_init.tooltip: Initialize the SD card in setup using the board default hardware SS/CS pin

arduino_sd_init_cs.tooltip: Initialize the SD card in setup using the specified chip-select pin

arduino_sd_init_clock.message0: initialize SD card CS pin %1 SPI clock %2 Hz
arduino_sd_init_clock.tooltip: Initialize the SD card in setup using the specified CS pin and SPI clock (SD 1.3.0 extended API)

arduino_sd_begin_result.message0: initialize SD card CS pin %1 successfully
arduino_sd_begin_result.tooltip: Call SD.begin(cs) immediately and return whether initialization succeeded, for retries or conditions

arduino_sd_end.tooltip: Close the SD root directory; call before removing or replacing the card

arduino_sd_exists.tooltip: Check whether a file or directory exists on the SD card

arduino_sd_path_operation.tooltip: Create a directory, delete a file, or remove an empty directory; mkdir also creates missing parent directories

arduino_sd_file_create.message0: open SD path %1 mode %2 save as file %3
arduino_sd_file_create.tooltip: Create a File variable and open a file or directory; FILE_WRITE appends at the end of a file

arduino_sd_file_create_next.message0: directory %1 open next entry mode %2 save as file %3
arduino_sd_file_create_next.tooltip: Get the next file or subdirectory from an open directory and save it in a new File variable

arduino_sd_file_is_open.tooltip: Check whether the File object is valid and open

arduino_sd_file_is_directory.tooltip: Check whether the current File object represents a directory

arduino_sd_file_name.tooltip: Return the 8.3 short name of the file or directory

arduino_sd_file_read.tooltip: Read or peek at the next byte; return -1 when no data is available, and peek does not advance the file position

arduino_sd_file_available.tooltip: Return the number of bytes currently available to read or write

arduino_sd_file_position.tooltip: Return the current read/write position or file size

arduino_sd_file_seek.tooltip: Move to the specified absolute byte offset and return whether it succeeded

arduino_sd_file_write.tooltip: Write with write, print, or println; the numeric base applies only to numeric print/println values

arduino_sd_file_control.tooltip: Flush the file, reset directory iteration, or close the File object
